notes:
Did: each source row has a More menu (aria-label 'More for <title>') with 'Replace with pasted text…', 'Replace from a file…' and 'Delete…'. Paste replace reuses PasteSourceDialog in a replacing mode (no title field, 'Adds version N+1. Earlier versions and the briefs built from them are kept.', 'Add version') and calls documents_replace {kind:'paste', text}; file replace calls documents_replace {kind:'import'} (a cancelled picker changes nothing). components/preparation/delete-source-alert.tsx is an AlertDialog modelled on delete-meeting-alert: it loads documents_delete_impact (new deleteDocumentImpact in document-service.ts) and says 'N briefs cite this source. Those lines will show the source as deleted. Its text will be removed from this Mac. This can't be undone.' (or 'No brief cites this source. ...'). An impact failure shows 'Couldn't check which briefs cite this source.' with Retry, and Delete stays disabled until the count loads. A failed delete keeps the alert open with 'Couldn't delete this source. Nothing was removed.' Cancel is disabled while deleting. After a replace, every selected version of that document is collapsed into the new version (if it extracted); after a delete, every selected version of it is dropped from the saved selection (the backend refuses deleted versions on save). Ownership is matched by the document's latest id, or by documents_get_version for selected versions that are not the latest of any listed document. Both flows call SourcesPanel's new onSourcesChanged; PreparationPage bumps briefingRevision and BriefingBlock's new revision prop reloads prep_get_briefing, so the brief's stale state and source_unavailable claims show at once. Tests: 11 in tests/components/source-actions.test.tsx, +1 in briefing-block.test (revision reloads). Gallery: preparation-source-menu, preparation-delete-source-alert (impact 2), preparation-replace-source, checked light and dark.
Assumptions: a replace whose new version failed extraction keeps the old version selected (it still has usable text) and shows no notice. DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND maps to 'This source was deleted.'
Learned: the real Radix DropdownMenu crashes under react-test-renderer, so every test that renders SourcesPanel with documents must mock components/ui/dropdown-menu (preparation-sources.test now does; knowledge-picker.test renders no documents). next/image in the alert needs window.location in the test window stub. Nit left: the alert keeps its previous impact count for one render on reopen before it goes back to loading. Gate passed on every run (184 gallery).
